name: Stop Motion: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Stop Motion look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, stop-motion puppet animation still, handmade clay and felt puppets with visible fingerprints and stitching, miniature set built from real materials, small practical lamps, shallow depth of field of a macro lens, warm tabletop lighting
negative_prompt: smooth cgi, photorealistic human, flat 2d, digital gloss, motion blur, text, watermark
